items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview

ctx.x: Oh, they did. They better had, they'd have ruined us. So, pretty soon -- we're sitting down -- better take anotherintermission. Got a little rough, but take another one before you play the last tune. So, while we're sitting downstairs in the cellar, I heard this, "Take your hands off of me." And we had three valets, one of them used to stay at one end of the bandstand, and the others at the two ends. Well, they were kind of timid. So, one of them, the big valet we had was right at the door to keep anybody from…

what I can't do. Take your hands off me." I said, "Oh, oh, Bushell this is your time." I'm right near the door. Something just -- just told me. I don't know what made me do it. Normally, I should have been hiding somewhere behind the door. I walked, went up the stairs and here this white fellow's trying to get down and Harold's got his hand on him. He said -- I said, "What's the problem?" "Well, this so and so wants to keep me from going down here to see Cab, you know, we loves Cab down here and I want to go talk…
